info.syllabusName: Quản lý sự thay đổi (Change Management)
info.description: The primary purpose of this course is to provide a basis for accreditation of people involved with Change Management at the foundation level. This foundation level is designed to measure whether a candidate has sufficient knowledge and understanding of the Change Management Text and Handbook to act as an informed member of a change management team during a period of change within part or all of their organization. This course is aimed at individuals who are involved in change programmes or organizations going through change, who require a working knowledge of the key principles of change management, who need to know the terminology used and some of the theory behind the practice.
